fact: The head of the National Authority for Remote Sensing and Space Sciences said the Authority works with the Ministry of Agriculture to monitor nine strategic crops, mainly wheat, rice, maize and sugar beet, estimating planted areas from satellite images and forecasting their productivity.
title: من الفضاء إلى الحقل.. كيف تساعد الأقمار الصناعية في تأمين غذاء المصريين؟
